articles.title: Kill Your Darlings, a great looking time-management dating-sim RPG gets a playtest and Kickstarter
articles.summary: Kill Your Darlings is an upcoming time-management dating-sim RPG from Stray Fawn Studio (The Wandering Village, Dungeon Clawler) that you can try now. Read the full article on GamingOnLinux .

articles.title: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang’s exit
articles.summary: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress reaffirmed the company’s commitment to open source AI during Tuesday’s earnings call with analysts — the first since CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation.

articles.title: Claude Code v2.1.327
articles.summary: Added claude mcp add-json <name> - to read the server's JSON from stdin, so tokens can stay off the command line; not available inside a Claude Code session.

articles.title: Morph 4K Firmware v4.0.8.6
articles.summary: PixelFX have just released a new firmware for their Morph 4K that adds an output screenshot option, improved VRR and an auto-zoom button. All v4 firmwares will now be on the “preview” channel, so to upgrade (regardless of what firmware you’re starting from), just open the OSD and go to System\Firmware\Update Channel.

articles.title: Linux in a Browser Tab
articles.summary: Unkernel is described as “Linux 7.x built as a single wasm module with an MMU.” Yes, thanks to the magic of WebAssembly, you can run Linux in a browser tab at a decent fraction of native speed.

articles.title: Tax and price updates for apps, In-App Purchases, and subscriptions
articles.summary: Pricing for apps and In-App Purchases will be updated for Botswana, Colombia, Egypt, Rwanda, and Türkiye if you haven’t selected one of these storefronts as the base storefront for your app or In‑App Purchase.² These updates also consider the VAT introductions listed in the tax updates section above.

articles.title: Material 3 Expressive adds scrolling time picker, AI Studio upgrades Android app creation
articles.summary: Google has given the time picker component a Material 3 Expressive redesign, while adding a new scrolling variant. Meanwhile, Google AI Studio is boosting its Android app development experience.

articles.title: Incremental horror game show Wheel of Torture looks worth keeping an eye on
articles.summary: After something spooky and a little different? Wheel of Torture combines the worlds of horror and incremental into something peculiar. Spin the wheel to earn money, invest in upgrades, and be careful: everything comes with a cost.

articles.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains
articles.summary: OpenAI also claims progress in web design. On the 3D benchmark AA-3D, human judges compare two blinded interactive experiences. GPT-6.2 Astra takes first with 1,318 Elo points, ahead of Claude Fable 5.2 at 1,271 and GPT-6.2 Sol at 1,259.

articles.title: External sandboxes for coding agents
articles.summary: External sandboxes for coding agents I've been exploring new ways to sandbox code that is executed by agents, with a focus on making it safer to try out local models without worrying that a mistake or prompt injection attack might cause them to take damaging actions on a machine.

articles.title: RetroTINK 6x CE / 4K – Bezel Updates
articles.summary: Mike Chi has just released some more RetroTINK 4K updates, focusing on the CRT bezel and curvature options. All CE/Pro’s now have new bezel options, as well as a “crop” feature where the bezel “snaps” to the any input with a dialed-in profile (or anything via HDMI).

articles.title: Coding on Windows? Redmond May Already Know.
articles.summary: Our own [Jenny List] took Windows 11 for a drive back in June , and emerged rather unimpressed. Your mileage may vary, but if you are, like the majority of the world’s desktop users, on Windows, you might want to double-check those privacy settings.

articles.title: YouTube Music removing Samples tab on Android & iOS
articles.summary: YouTube Music is simplifying its core navigation on Android and iOS by removing the Samples tab, though the vertical video format remains in the app.

articles.title: Unity acquired Synty Studios to power Unity Spark, their AI game creation platform
articles.summary: Today I’m proud to share that Unity has acquired Synty Studios . The founders and artists behind the POLYGON range of stylized 3D art packs are joining the Unity team, and their library is coming to Unity Spark , our upcoming AI-native game creation platform.

articles.title: Model ML raises $250M to automate investment banking grunt work
articles.summary: Model ML, a London-based startup that uses AI to automate work traditionally performed by junior bankers and consultants, including building financial models, preparing pitch decks, and writing due diligence reports, has raised $250 million in Series B funding at a $1.5 billion valuation.

articles.title: Running the full server-side Datasette Python app in the browser with service workers and Pyodide
articles.summary: Datasette Lite is my port of the Datasette Python application to run directly in the browser using WebAssembly and Pyodide . I've released a complete rewrite of Datasette Lite using service workers, and it's now almost indistinguishable from the real server-side application.

articles.title: Get some quality open world games in the Survival of the Fittest Humble Bundle
articles.summary: Humble is back in action with a rather good one here. The Survival of the Fittest Humble Bundle has arrived with some really good picks.

articles.title: Google to keep Gemini chats for 2 months, up from 72 hours, even with history off
articles.summary: Google is extending how long it keeps temporary Gemini chats and conversations made with chat history turned off to around two months, saying the change aims to improve safety and security as AI systems become more capable.

articles.title: AirPods Pro 3 keep getting better, here’s what’s new in iOS 27
articles.summary: AirPods got a variety of new features this fall in iOS 27, several of which are exclusive to AirPods Pro 3 (now only $179) .

articles.title: WhatsApp starts rolling out built-in cloud backup on Android, and it’s free
articles.summary: “WhatsApp cloud storage” is showing up in the WhatsApp for Android v2.26.46.4 beta update, rolling out now, and includes 2GB of free storage for cloud backups.

articles.title: As decision model use skyrockets, is customization the next frontier?
articles.summary: In October, more than one in four requests on Vercel’s AI model router went to decision models, not LLMs — an enormous share of work for a kind of computerized intelligence that was invented only a month earlier.

articles.title: 9to5Mac Daily: November 17, 2026 – iOS 27.3 brings face unlock to iPhone Duo, more
articles.summary: Listen to a recap of the top stories of the day from 9to5Mac . 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes and Apple’s Podcasts app , Stitcher , TuneIn , Google Play , or through our dedicated RSS feed for Overcast and other podcast players.

articles.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol now available
articles.summary: OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol are now generally available in GitHub Copilot. Both models are designed for agentic coding and code review, with stronger coding judgment than earlier GPT-6 models.

articles.title: GitHub Copilot Fusion updates: more availability, benchmarks, and models
articles.summary: Today, we’re expanding GitHub Copilot Fusion with new models, available on more Copilot surfaces, and results on two public Terminal-Bench leaderboards, giving you more ways to use Fusion and compare its performance.

articles.title: Put Gemini to work for you
articles.summary: As Gemini becomes more capable, we continually advance our security defenses. When you assign Gemini a task, it uses Google Cloud’s Agent Compute Engine to work in a hardware-isolated virtual machine that’s dedicated to your account and never shared with other users.

articles.title: GitHub Copilot app, Microsoft Ignite releases
articles.summary: Copilot is most useful when it can work where you do. The GitHub Copilot app now supports your Azure DevOps repositories, your GitHub Enterprise Server instance, and the browser you’re already signed in to.

articles.title: Copilot code review: Adaptive effort, secret detection, and more
articles.summary: Adaptive never picks a level above the maximum review effort level set for your enterprise, organization, or repository. To learn more, see Configuring code review by GitHub Copilot .

articles.title: Dhruva Dock extension for GNOME revives old school desktop bling
articles.summary: Ubuntu’s had a dock (or launcher, if you will) down the left-hand side of the screen since it made Unity the default desktop in 2011, a design point it stuck to when it switched back to GNOME in 2017.

articles.title: MNT Reform Next, the ultra-open laptop, starts shipping
articles.summary: I was pleased to see see (via notebookcheck ) it’s started shipping high-end Hyper configurations of its laptop model, the MNT Reform Next , to backers of its 2025 crowdfunding campaign via Crowd Supply.

articles.title: New AMDGPU Linux Patches From Valve Aim To Reduce Stuttering With Steam Play Games
articles.summary: Natalie Vock of Valve's Linux graphics driver team sent out a new version of AMDGPU kernel driver patches today that aim to provide 'significant reductions in stuttering' for some newer Windows games running on Linux by way of Steam Play (Proton).
